title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
content: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
content: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder 117,000 NEAR, worth about $430,000, from the $6.3 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says.

title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks amid Wall Street's blockchain race
content: Avalanche will serve as the core settlement ledger for the exchange's planned blockchain stock market

title: Solana set for its first tokenized stock venue under SEC framework, listing Galaxy
content: Formation Securities plans to launch in early 2027 with Galaxy, Exodus and Forward Industries shares, expanding the U.S. regulator's experiment in blockchain-based stock trading.

title: Trump says he knows ‘nothing’ about World Liberty’s UAE ties as Justin Sun challenges filings
content: Trump confirmed he co-owns World Liberty, whose UAE ownership could derail Justin Sun’s federal lawsuit over frozen WLFI tokens

title: Analysts see no broader ‘contagion’ from $6.3B Binance hack
content: Binance’s pledge to cover all user losses helped contain the fallout from the $6.3 billion hack, analysts said.

title: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
content: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.

title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
content: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing.

title: EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities
content: Applications close Nov. 27 for an industry group that aims to draft initial standards for holding and settling tokenized securities by early 2028.

title: NYSE Taps Avalanche to Settle Its Planned Tokenized Stock Platform
content: Ava Labs said Avalanche will serve as the “core ledger technology” for the clearing firm behind the NYSE-affiliated venue, which aims to bring 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized securities onchain.

title: Strategy Buys $82M in Bitcoin, Buys Back $188M of STRC
content: The Bitcoin treasury firm sold $284 million of MSTR stock to fund the moves, days before MSCI names companies facing index removal.

title: Microsoft-Backed Space and Time Launches Platform to Let AI Agents Verify Private Data
content: Space and Time Enterprise uses Proof of SQL to prove calculations on private business data without exposing the records to AI agents.

title: Coinbase Joins Circle, Ripple With Final OCC Approval for Federal Trust Bank Charter
content: The exchange will move its institutional crypto custody business under federal oversight, building on its 2018 New York trust charter.

title: Trump Says He Knows 'Nothing' About World Liberty Financial as He Defends UAE Ties
content: Pressed on why he doesn't divest from the family's crypto venture, Trump said his sons run the business and every president faces conflicts.

title: Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29
content: Bitcoin Magazine Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29 Binance told users in France, Spain, Italy and Poland to withdraw their crypto, with deposits blocked, accounts closing Dec. 31 and a monthly fee starting Nov. 29, as the exchange still lacks an EU license. This post Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: U.S. Regulators Drop $250 Travel Rule Plan, Crypto Language Too
content: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Regulators Drop $250 Travel Rule Plan, Crypto Language Too FinCEN and the Federal Reserve formally withdrew a 2020 proposal that would have cut the cross-border funds-transfer threshold from $3,000 to $250 and spelled out that the rules cover crypto, saying any future version needs a fresh comment period. This post U.S. Regulators Drop $250 Travel Rule Plan, Crypto Language Too first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Kraken’s Dave Ripley: “That Was the Bear Market” and Bitcoin Is “On Our Way Out of It”

title: Strive (ASST) Adds 29 Bitcoin for $2.2 Million as Weekly Buys Slow After Crossing 43,000
content: Bitcoin Magazine Strive (ASST) Adds 29 Bitcoin for $2.2 Million as Weekly Buys Slow After Crossing 43,000 Strive purchased 29 bitcoin from Oct. 31 to Nov. 6 at an average of $75,721, lifting holdings to 43,153 BTC while cash slipped to $487.6 million and SATS preferred shares edged higher. This post Strive (ASST) Adds 29 Bitcoin for $2.2 Million as Weekly Buys Slow After Crossing 43,000 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Coinbase Wins Full Federal Trust Charter From OCC
content: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase Wins Full Federal Trust Charter From OCC Coinbase's custody arm has completed its national trust bank charter with the OCC, upgrading April's conditional approval, but the license does not let it take deposits, make loans or issue stablecoins. This post Coinbase Wins Full Federal Trust Charter From OCC first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
